description: The leading company in employing domestic and specialized workforce in Saudi Arabia and Bangladesh. Al-Muraisi International was established in Saudi Arabia and Bangladesh, and has since distinguished itself by providing the best services for employing domestic workers, drivers, and specialized workforce from various nationalities. We have strong relationships with employment offices in labor-exporting countries, enabling us to provide the best competencies in the shortest time and at the best prices. We guarantee our clients reliable and highly efficient domestic staff and specialized workforce.
